purpose: Define the first prospective externally anchored HB/Master Records successor checkpoint while preserving historical HB-only evidence as system-relative continuity only.

first_successor_checkpoint.root_inclusion_rule: Only canonical Master Records receipts inside the explicit activation-floor/query-ceiling range are eligible for external-time inheritance. Historical receipts below the activation floor remain excluded even if independently reconstructable.
first_successor_checkpoint.checkpoint_digest_rule: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of the complete checkpoint body with checkpoint_commitment_sha256 omitted.

external_anchor.inherited_scope: Only the first-successor checkpoint and in-scope receipt identities committed under its activation floor/ceiling may inherit the confirmed external temporal bound.

invariants: Master Records remains custody/reconstruction authority only.
External anchoring never grants execution, transition, admission, custody, credential, routing, publication, or governance authority.
No historical HB-only receipt is retroactively promoted to externally anchored evidence.
A confirmed external anchor must verify the exact checkpoint_commitment_sha256.
Deletion, insertion, replacement, or reordering of an in-scope receipt must change the deterministic Master Records root or fail reconstruction.
